issue.title: Add a Deck View glossary strand and link it from the card, card-block, and deck-panel strands

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by sase-1b1.7 note #2 (epic sase-1b1, deck views; plan:202609/deck_views.md). Deck views shipped on master in 9c4d104aff..5cafbcb53f, and docs/ace.md "Deck Views" describes them, but the glossary web has no term for them.

1. Add a new strand `glossary/deck-view.md` ("Deck View"; aliases: view policy, deck view badge). Define the three layouts: `spread` (every card on one page), `page cards` (one whole card per page), and `page blocks` (one card block per page). Cover automatic vs fixed policy: automatic resolves via `ace.agent_decks.spread_max_screens` / `block_spread_max_screens`, and fixed bypasses those thresholds. Describe the title badge (`page blocks · auto`, `spread · fixed`), the `P` widening cycle (page blocks -> page cards -> spread, wrapping, skipping equivalent layouts), and the palette "Deck view: automatic" reset. Views are stored per panel and per deck in `~/.sase/ace_agents_deck_state.json`.
2. Scope statement (shared rule R9 between epics sase-1b1 and sase-1b2): deck views apply to the Main and Files decks only. Tools, and FINAL when `ace_final_deck` is on, always page automatically, show no badge, and `P` does not apply there. Keep this consistent with sase-1b2.20's proposed glossary:agent-data-deck edit, which lists FINAL among the decks.
3. Mention the view with a [[deck-view]] link in `glossary/agent-data-card.md`, `glossary/agent-data-card-block.md` (page blocks is the block-paged layout), and `glossary/deck-panel.md` (views are per panel).

issue.creation_reason: Deck views (sase-1b1) shipped with docs but no glossary term; sase-1b1.7 proposed the strand and shared rule R9 requires it to agree with sase-1b2's agent-data-deck edit.
